description: Download every message this server has not saved before (oldest first) and remember it, so a scheduled call keeps a complete archive: SPV drops most documents about two months after posting them. Filters narrow what is synced; `limit` caps one call and `remaining` says how many are left for the next. Answers what was saved, with paths and SHA-256. A client that asks for progress hears each document saved; cancelling stops between documents, and the next sync carries on from there.

cif.description: Only documents for this tax id (a CNP or a CUI), for an account that holds several.

limit.description: At most this many downloads in this call.

save_dir.description: A folder INSIDE the downloads outbox (e.g. "2026-10"); empty means the outbox itself. A path outside it is refused.

since.description: Posted on or after: a calendar date in Bucharest, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

type.description: Only this SPV document type, as list_messages' `types` names it: DECIZIE, SOMATII, NOTIFICARE, RASPUNS SOLICITARE, PLATA, RECIPISA, ... (case and diacritics ignored).

until.description: Posted on or before: a calendar date in Bucharest, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

name: sync_messages
title: Save every new message
